check_description: season_year must be present because it is the structural identifier of the season.
Primary key ['season_year'] must be unique and non-null.
season_year must be 2021 or 2022.
season_start_date must be a valid date when present.
season_end_date must be a valid date when present.
number_of_events must be greater than zero when present.
season_start_date must be before season_end_date when both are present.
The year component of season dates must be coherent with season_year.
Circuit identifier and analytical classification columns must be present.
Primary key ['circuit_id'] must be unique and non-null.
global_circuit_category must belong to the allowed domain.
sector1_category must belong to the allowed domain.
sector2_category must belong to the allowed domain.
sector3_category must belong to the allowed domain.
Circuit textual attributes must not be empty strings when present.
driver_id, abbreviation, and last_name must be present.
Primary key ['driver_id'] must be unique and non-null.
abbreviation must be a short uppercase alphabetic driver code.
date_of_birth must be a valid date when present.
driver_url must have a valid URL format when present.
permanent_number must be positive when present.
Driver textual attributes must not be empty strings when present.
Driver age during 2021--2022 should be within a broad plausible range.
team_id and team_name must be present.
Primary key ['team_id'] must be unique and non-null.
team_id must be a non-empty lowercase textual identifier.
team_url must have a valid URL format when present.
team_name and nationality must not be empty strings when present.
grand_prix_id, season_year, round_number, and circuit_id must be present.
Primary key ['grand_prix_id'] must be unique and non-null.
Natural key ['season_year', 'round_number'] should be unique.
round_number must be greater than zero.
event_date must be a valid date when present.
event_format must belong to the allowed event format domain when present.
Testing events must not be included.
f1_api_support must be boolean when present.
Grand Prix textual attributes must not be empty strings when present.
event_date must be coherent with season_year when present.
The event-to-circuit matching result must be present and referentially valid.
grand_prix.season_year must reference season.season_year.
grand_prix.circuit_id must reference circuit.circuit_id.
session_id, grand_prix_id, and session_type must be present.
Primary key ['session_id'] must be unique and non-null.
Natural key ['grand_prix_id', 'session_type'] should be unique.
session_type must be Q or R.
session_date must be a valid date when present.
session_date should be coherent with the corresponding Grand Prix event_date.
session.grand_prix_id must reference grand_prix.grand_prix_id.
result_id, session_id, driver_id, team_id, and position should be present.
Primary key ['result_id'] must be unique and non-null.
Natural key ['session_id', 'driver_id'] should be unique.
position must be greater than zero when present.
points must be greater than or equal to zero when present.
laps must be greater than or equal to zero when present.
classified_position and status must not be empty strings when present.
result.session_id must reference session.session_id.
result.driver_id must reference driver.driver_id.
result.team_id must reference team.team_id.
Structural lap identifiers must be present.
Main lap performance attributes are checked for analytical completeness.
Primary key ['lap_id'] must be unique and non-null.
Natural key ['session_id', 'driver_id', 'lap_number'] should be unique.
lap_number must be greater than zero.
lap_time_ms must be positive when present.
Sector times must be positive when present.
Speed attributes must be positive when present.
stint must be positive when present.
tyre_life must be positive when present.
compound must belong to the expected tyre compound domain when present.
Lap boolean attributes must contain valid boolean values when present.
For normal timed laps, the sum of sector times should be coherent with lap_time_ms.
team_id in lap should be coherent with the corresponding result row.
Lap times, sector times, and speeds are checked only with broad plausibility ranges.
lap.session_id must reference session.session_id.
lap.driver_id must reference driver.driver_id.
lap.team_id must reference team.team_id.
Weather identifier, session timeline, and main weather measures must be present.
Primary key ['weather_id'] must be unique and non-null.
Natural key ['session_id', 'time_ms'] should be unique.
time_ms must be greater than or equal to zero.
air_temp must be within a broad plausible physical range when present.
track_temp must be within a broad plausible physical range when present.
humidity must be between 0 and 100 when present.
pressure must be within a realistic atmospheric range when present.
rainfall must be boolean when present.
wind_direction must be a degree value between 0 and 360 when present.
wind_speed must be greater than or equal to zero when present.
track_temp should be reasonably coherent with air_temp.
weather.session_id must reference session.session_id.
Track status identifier, session timeline, status, and message must be present.
Primary key ['track_status_id'] must be unique and non-null.
Natural key ['session_id', 'time_ms'] should be unique.
time_ms must be greater than or equal to zero.
status must belong to the documented track status code domain.
message must belong to the documented track status message domain.
message must not be an empty string.
The same numerical status code should always correspond to the same textual message.
track_status.session_id must reference session.session_id.
